name: ECU wake-up on ignition (example)
description: Neutral example: the ECU must send its heartbeat within 300 ms after ignition ON.
testRunSteps:
Given the bench is ready
And the supply is set to <supply>
And the supply output is switched on
Then the supply current is below 1 mA
When the ignition is switched on

Then CAN frame 0x1A0 is received within 500 ms
And the wake-up time is below 300 ms

When the ignition is switched off
And the bench waits 200 ms
Back to sleep (shown only, not executed)
